mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5% in a single month, it signals a shift toward monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payroll growth signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts below 2000 thousand units signals weakening demand for residential construction, which precedes economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate over the prior month indicates weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 115.0 in a single month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 115.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (above 2.0% annualized) and decline in housing starts (below 2000 thousand units) signals rising inflation and weakening demand, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annualized and HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum signals restrictive policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
